detail:
Full summary: Wave 1 T3: files-backend index-desync detection + repair shipped — DecisionStore.repairIndexDesync (preview/execute under the index lock, unparseable files untouched), housekeeping repair_index pass with never-silent index_repair_error on sqlite, and a twining_status warning naming the repair path.
Decisions: Chose duck-typing repairIndexDesync on the concrete DecisionStore over widening IDecisionStore — the sqlite backend has no decisions/index.json, and a forced interface no-op would turn 'cannot run' into silent success, the exact reads-as-success shape the audit documents; housekeeping reports index_repair_error instead.; Chose to treat a missing/unreadable index.json as empty during desync detection (all decision files count as orphans) rather than failing — that state is the extreme form of the desync the pass exists to catch.
